action.intent: Inspect fortress food and drink supplies on the status screen.

Let the repeating barrel job and farm work proceed.
Inspect the still's brewing options after barrel production.
Queue plant brewing on repeat and allow production to proceed.

Inspect carpenter jobs and whether dining furniture is ready.
Place the first completed table in the underground living area.
Inspect the flooded-looking fortress floor to identify the dangerous terrain blocking work.

Move the still onto dry grass near the wagon and select construction material.
Select the nearby log to construct the surface still and allow construction time.
Inspect the new surface still and its available workshop jobs.
Open the surface still's job menu to start brewing.

Add a plant brewing job at the surface still and set it to repeat.
Close the brewing ingredient details and inspect the still menu.
Open plant-gathering designations to supply food and brewing ingredients.
Designate a broad patch of surface plants for gathering.
Resume the fortress so designated shrubs can be gathered and workshop jobs can progress.
Inspect building tasks to prepare brewing at the surface still.
Inspect the surface still and its brewing jobs.
Inspect available brewing jobs at the surface still.
Let plant gathering and barrel production progress before retrying brewing.
Check whether gathered plants and barrels now permit brewing.
Place a bed on dry surface ground near the workshops.
Inspect carpenter jobs to replenish beds and barrels.
Leave the build menu and return to the embark area to locate the workshops.
Inspect the still's available brewing jobs.
Check what prevents brewing from plants.
Return to the map and let dwarves gather plants and finish queued work.
Start placing the finished beds on dry surface ground.

Inspect the carpenter's workshop and its pending furniture jobs.

Place the first bed on clear ground beside the carpenter.
Start a new sheltered sleeping area farther from the river; outdoor beds require a roof.

Excavate a room beside the new staircase, away from the flooded southern chambers.

Place beds in the newly excavated dry shelter.

Inspect the installed bed and prepare a shared sleeping room.
